metadata.description: The SkillCDN pack as plugins: skills for an AI agent to do real company work, one plugin per area of work. The same folders are served live through SkillCDN at skillcdn.ai/gh/skillcdn/skills.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Marketing and growth: ads, ad and product research, promotional video, content, campaigns, posting to social accounts. A short-form AI ad from a reference video and a product link, and research in the Meta Ad Library for ad creatives and for rising products.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Original video and audio content: scripted short dramas, series episodes and story-driven shorts. One episode of a vertical short drama on Higgsfield from a premise or a series bible, with native dialogue, verified lines and coded subtitles.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Software development and the tooling an agent works with: code, a codebase's documents, apps, testing, debugging. A skill written from work already done with an agent and a skill verified again from a fresh session; documents turned into a pack an agent searches through SkillCDN, research in such a pack and an answer from it with every citation checked; a new web app built and put live on Cloudflare; payments with Stripe from a sandbox to live money; Meta ads from the pixel to running campaigns; the operator's dashboard as a separate Worker behind Cloudflare Access.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design work in the team's design tool or drafted as rendered pages before it: slides and decks, card news, brand assets, icons and store graphics. A document moved into an existing Figma Slides deck as new slides in the deck's own measured design system, audited by numbers and zoomed renders; a first-draft deck as HTML and PDF from an outline, in the organization's own tokens; four looks for one design (a page, a deck, a post, a card news format), rendered as HTML and compared on a contact sheet, judged for the AI feel before they are shown; a reference account's card news format measured into a spec from the posts visible without signing in; and a card news carousel built from a sourced brief in a spec's own slide types, as HTML rendered to PNG.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product planning and research: discovery, research synthesis, a sourced brief of a story, concept directions and alternatives, requirements, specifications, roadmaps, prioritization. Four to six concept directions that get a reference's effect by other means, placed on the axes a concept can move on, judged for the AI feel and compared with a recommendation and a runner-up, then handed to the skill that produces; and this week's candidate stories in the categories an account covers, the user's pick turned into a topic brief with every fact traced to an article sentence and the images that show the story collected with their credits.
